name: Change My Mind
visual_description: Steven Crowder sitting outdoors behind a folding table with a coffee mug and a white banner.
usage_context: Used to express an assertive, unpopular, or humorous opinion challenging others to convince you otherwise.

example.sign_text: Maggi tastes better when cooked by someone else.

text_areas.description: The controversial opinion or statement written on the banner above 'CHANGE MY MIND'
